comingLast.roast: 3 points buys freedom - Crouch is pricing it higher by the minute
one quiet stretch from joining Rafter in the conversation nobody wants
the buffer reads 4 - his group reads it aloud each tee
the blue balls are 4 points away and gaining slowly
above Rafter by 7 - the safety rope is more of a shoelace
7 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
